title: Loopback Driver Configuration
description: Per-driver-type schema for `type: loopback` entries (FR-DF-004). A synthetic, hardware-free driver (Sprint 17, XEDGE-137) — each tag's value is whatever was last written to it (or its `initial_value` before any write). Useful as a demo/test data source with no field device needed, and used standalone by the diagnostic `self-test` command to prove the driver-to-pipeline path works.

scan_rate_ms.description: 100ms minimum sampling interval, matching the other polling drivers.

initial_value.description: Value reported before any write() — defaults to 0.
